description.value:
The minds at Serbia-based Rostović set out to prove that "smart" doesn't have to mean "expensive." The fruit of their endeavor is the Palica, based on their time-tested Igla model. Was the experiment a success? Opinions are divided. The Palica's price is certainly lower than the competition, but so it also has the craftsmanship to match. This shotgun possesses the basic functionality of a Smart-class shotgun, but it's not worth the breath required to compare it to Arasaka or Tsunami weapons. Still, for those whose wallets are already squeezed, the Palica really is the "smart" choice.

Cost: 250eb (Expensive)

Class: PQ Shotgun • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Short Barrel Shotgun

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 2 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Shotgun Shell

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Smart Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Incompatible with Capacity modifying Attachments. Can only load Improved Smart Ammunition. Despite being One-Handed, this weapon cannot be installed into as a Popup Weapon.

Range: Short Barrel Shotgun
Pre-installed: Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Shotgun Shell

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
